域名名称。<props="china">可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
description.en: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the domain name.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
默认为**zh**
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English Default: **zh**

description.zh:
解析线路，默认为**default**。参见：

<props="china">[解析线路枚举](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29807.html)</props>

<props="intl">[解析线路枚举](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm)</props>
description.en:
The resolution line. Default value: **default**. For more information, see

[DNS resolution lines](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm).

description.zh:
MX记录的优先级，取值范围：`[1,50]`。

记录类型为MX记录时，此参数必需，MX 优先级的数值越低，优先级别就越高。
description.en:
The priority of the mail exchanger (MX) record. Valid values: `1 to 50`.

This parameter is required if the type of the DNS record is MX. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh:
主机记录。

如果要解析exmaple.com，主机记录要填写”@”，而不是空。
description.en:
The hostname.

For example, to resolve @.example.com, you must set this parameter to an at sign (@). You cannot leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
解析生效时间，默认为600秒（10分钟）。参见：

<props="china">[TTL定义说明](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29806.html)</props>

<props="intl">[TTL定义说明](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29806.htm)</props>
description.en:
The time to live (TTL) period of the Alibaba Cloud DNS (DNS) record. Default value: 600. Unit: seconds. For more information, see

[TTL definition](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29806.htm).

description.zh:
解析记录类型，参见：


<props="china">[解析记录类型格式](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29805.html)</props>


<props="intl">[解析记录类型格式](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29805.htm)</props>
description.en:
The type of the DNS record. For more information, see

[DNS record types](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29805.htm).
The IP address of the client.
The value of the DNS record.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-domain-record --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.1 --domain-name example.com --rr www --type A --value 192.168.0.1 --ttl 600 --priority 1 --line default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns AddDomainRecord --region cn-hangzhou --RR www --Line default --Type A --DomainName 'example.com' --Priority 1 --UserClientIp '192.0.2.1' --Value '192.168.0.1' --Lang en --TTL 600
